text:
ara: Heads-up: todays deploy toggled a more aggressive quota sampler; some SDKs interpret missing x-sample header as 0 which collapses dashboard sparklines.
mike: Which header are we emitting now?
ara: We started sending x-sample-mode: aggressive|steady in addition to numeric x-sample-rate, but the numeric is omitted when short-circuited.
jules: Ok. Quick fix in SDKs: prefer numeric if >0, else map x-sample-mode to fallback rate. I'll patch the TS lib.
kevin: I'll do Go and add an integration test asserting metrics don't drop to 0 for missing numeric header.
ara: Python owner?
mike: That's me. I'll add SampleResolver with tag mapping and an env flag to opt-in.
jules: Can we avoid a full DB migration? Product wants minimal customer impact.
ara: Yes, we'll emit x-sample-mode as optional header only. No migration needed for now. If we later want historical mode queries we'll schedule migration.
kevin: Rollout plan: SDK opt-in behind env var -> backend emit for 10% canary tenants -> 24h observe -> 50% -> full.
mike: I'll include changelog and migration guidance: upgrade to SDK >= v2.4.1 to avoid 0% artifacts.
release-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-8431 "sampling-mode header SDK rollout" assigned to ara, mike, jules, kevin.
ara: Thanks team. Sync in #release-war-room when canary flips. :rocket:
